cards.front: What makes a sound louder?
cards.back: A bigger vibration.
cards.say: What makes a sound louder? A bigger vibration.

cards.front: What makes a sound quieter?
cards.back: A smaller vibration.
cards.say: What makes a sound quieter? A smaller vibration.

cards.front: What makes the pitch higher?
cards.back: A faster vibration.
cards.say: What makes the pitch higher? A faster vibration.

cards.front: What makes the pitch lower?
cards.back: A slower vibration.

cards.front: How do you play a guitar string louder?
cards.back: Pluck it harder, so it vibrates more.
cards.say: How do you play a guitar string louder? Pluck it harder, so it vibrates more.

cards.front: How do you get a higher note on a guitar string?
cards.back: Make the string shorter or tighter.

cards.front: How do you get a lower note on a guitar string?
cards.back: Make the string longer or looser.
cards.say: How do you get a lower note on a guitar string? Make the string longer or looser.

cards.front: Which string makes a higher note, thin or thick?
cards.back: Thin, because thin strings vibrate faster.

cards.front: Which string makes a lower note, thin or thick?
cards.back: Thick.

cards.front: Which pitch does a short ruler make, high or low?
cards.back: High, because the short part vibrates faster.

cards.front: Which pitch does a long ruler make, high or low?
cards.back: Low.

cards.front: Does a small drum or a big drum make a lower sound?
cards.back: A big drum.

cards.front: Which has a lower pitch, a tuba or a flute?
cards.back: A tuba.

cards.front: amplitude
cards.back: The size of a vibration. A larger vibration gives a louder sound.
cards.say: amplitude. The size of a vibration. A larger vibration gives a louder sound.

cards.front: Is a loud sound always a high sound?
cards.back: No. Pitch and volume are different.
cards.say: Is a loud sound always a high sound? No. Pitch and volume are different.

cards.front: Is a whisper quiet or loud?
cards.back: Quiet.

cards.front: What unit measures volume of sound?
cards.back: Decibels (dB).
cards.say: What unit measures volume of sound? Decibels (dB).

cards.front: Why is very loud sound harmful?
cards.back: It can damage the ears.

cards.front: How can you protect your ears from loud sound?
cards.back: Wear ear defenders or move away.

cards.front: What happens to sound as you move away from it?
cards.back: It gets quieter.

cards.back: False. High means fast vibration. Loud means big vibration.
